title: Morris Water Maze Protocol
author: Aroa S Maroto
materials: Put the rat on the platform.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Software
steps.instruction: Configure the recording system and platform hardware.

substeps.instruction: Check camera settings.
Start the Bonsai workflow and verify it is recording at 30 fps.
Introduce the Atlantis platform into the pool and ensure it moves correctly, avoiding waves during up-and-down movements.

steps.title: Set Platform Position
steps.instruction: Position the platform for the day's session.

substeps.instruction: Place the platform in a different space from the previous day.

steps.title: Conduct Initial Trial
steps.instruction: Perform the first trial of the experiment.

substeps.instruction: Place the animal in the desired start position in the maze, facing the tank center; lower it gently to avoid splashing.
Start a timer or computer tracking program the moment the animal is released and the operator leaves the experimental area.
Stop the timer when the animal reaches (touches) the platform, observing a trial limit of 2 min.

steps.title: Perform Platform Transition
steps.instruction: Adjust the platform visibility and accessibility.

substeps.instruction: Put the platform down so it is not possible for the animal to use.
Wait 1 minute, then press the button to raise the platform.
Put the platform up so it is possible to use but not visible.

steps.title: Conduct Subsequent Trials
steps.instruction: Execute trials using randomized start positions.

substeps.instruction: Place the animal in a start position different from each trial, facing the tank center; lower it gently to avoid splashing.
Start the timer or computer tracking program the moment the animal is released and the operator leaves the experimental area.
Stop the timer when the animal reaches (touches) the platform, observing a trial limit of 1 min.

steps.title: Post-Trial Animal Care
steps.instruction: Remove the animal and allow for recovery.

substeps.instruction: Remove the animal and place it in the cage for drying.
Leave the animal for 5 minutes until the next trial.

steps.title: Prepare for Trial 2
steps.instruction: Reset the environment and animal for the second trial set.

substeps.instruction: Wait 30 minutes before starting trial 2.
Put the platform up so it is possible to use but not visible.

steps.title: Execute Trial 2 Sequence
steps.instruction: Perform the second trial set with randomized positioning.

substeps.instruction: Place the animal in a randomly chosen start position, facing the tank center; lower it gently to avoid splashing.
Start the timer or computer tracking program the moment the animal is released and the operator leaves the experimental area.
Stop the timer when the animal reaches (touches) the platform or when 1 min has passed.
Remove the animal and place it in the cage for drying.
Leave the animal for 5 minutes until the next trial.
